bosses.name: The Pseudo-Unwinged
bosses.description: He cast aside his real body and stole a false name, wandering through the shadows of the network. In the end, the Sixth Sin became the cage that trapped him.

buffs.name: Frost
buffs.description: The phenomenon of freezing expansion will occur at low temperatures. Ice DMG received is increased significantly.

skills.name: Adrift
skills.description: The Pseudo-Unwinged uses wingsuit thrusters to move and reposition.

skills.name: Suppressive Assault
skills.description: The Pseudo-Unwinged launches a dense multi-weapon assault. It thrusts forward, switches to close-range hand cannons, retreats using recoil, then deploys drones for follow-up suppression.

skills.name: Overload Rays
skills.description: The Pseudo-Unwinged has drones form a power gate, then fires pulse beams from the arm cannon. Once the beams pass through the gate, they are amplified into Overload Rays.

skills.name: Roaming Blades
skills.description: The Pseudo-Unwinged has drones merge into a shuriken, takes off, then dives down to slash at the target. After pulling back and sweeping across with a backhand strike, the Pseudo-Unwinged closes in again for continuous spinning slashes, then retreats and lands as the drones break apart and open fire on the target.

skills.name: Cyclone Uppercut
skills.description: The Pseudo-Unwinged drifts left using wingsuit thrusters, performs a diagonal slash, then follows with an upward cut before stabilizing its frame.

bosses.name: Skych
bosses.description: Skych is a former butler of the Norman Mining Corp who was modified into an Experiment at the Konstantin Mine. Sometimes rational, sometimes crazy, Skych always defends the glory of the Norman Mining Corp.

buffs.name: Frail
buffs.description: Cannot resist physical impacts after the structure is weakened. Physical DMG received is increased significantly.

skills.name: Charged Slash
skills.description: Skych breaks the ground with the impact drill and leaps to sweep the drill and attack the enemy.

skills.name: Leap Bombardment
skills.description: Skych breaks the ground with the impact drill and leaps behind the enemy to launch a powerful bombardment.

skills.name: Lava Bombardment
skills.description: Skych fills his heavy artillery with the lava on the ground and bombards forward, dealing massive damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Shattering Slam
skills.description: Skych stomps the ground to create shockwaves, dealing damage to enemies in front.

skills.name: Shattering Raid
skills.description: Skych launches an assault at the enemy and then bombards the ground with his heavy artillery.

bosses.name: Melinoe
bosses.description: A mechanoid doctor born to devour the poisons of the human heart. With silk and claw, she weaves deadly illusions in a hopeless offering to her lost love.

buffs.name: Corrosion
buffs.description: The internal structure has been corroded by excessively stored radiant energy. Dark DMG received is increased significantly.

skills.name: Arachnid Leap
skills.description: Melinoe leaps up and slams down, unleashing a spreading shockwave.

skills.name: Deadly Pierce
skills.description: Melinoe raises her bone sword and thrusts it at the target.

skills.name: Web Ambush
skills.description: Melinoe transforms spider silk into a slingshot and launches a charged projectile.

skills.name: Venom Waltz
skills.description: Melinoe fires a strand of spider silk to hook her target, yanking herself into a ferocious spinning slash.

skills.name: Silken Cross
skills.description: Melinoe swings her bone sword to perform a double slash.

skills.name: Briar Ward
skills.description: With a horizontal sword sweep, Melinoe calls forth spikes from the earth that knock back nearby enemies.

skills.name: Thorned Judgment
skills.description: Melinoe raises her bone sword high and brings it down in a cleaving arc.
